command: PATH="$PWD/build/frontend-node-24.20.0-npm-11.19.0.BpJuvR/node/bin:$PATH" ./gradlew --no-daemon -x verifyFrontendToolchain test --tests 'decompengine.web.UploadServerTest.HTTP job status remains responsive throughout a slow multi-record dashboard listing'
test: HTTP job status remains responsive throughout a slow multi-record dashboard listing
scope: Local deterministic HTTP qualification: two status clients continue real GET /api/jobs/{id} requests while the dashboard traverses eight uploaded jobs with a 250 ms delay at each physical job.json read. Four successful status responses are required while the first, third, and sixth distinct records are held; all responses must be HTTP 200 under two seconds, and final dashboard output must include all eight jobs. JUnit system-out retains each request latency, distinct-record progress and dashboard completion state.
limitations: The artificial metadata delay is in-process; this does not measure physical-disk contention or deployment throughput.
Does not qualify live deployment behavior or hosted CI.
Does not complete the broader #162 upload/listing quota matrix or issue acceptance.
